skills.name: Butterfly Strike (香气袭人/香りに包まれる)
skills.line: Just because it smells nice, doesn't mean it is nice
skills.description: Kochou no Sei flaps her wings to waft destructive pollen at a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Graceful Agility (轻盈/窈窕)
skills.description: Kochou no Sei's SPD increases by 10 for every 30% of HP lost by the ally with the lowest proportion of HP

upgrades.text: Lost HP threshold decreases to 20% and if she gains 4 buffs from Graceful Agility, the onibi cost for Dance of Hope is decreased by 2.

skills.name: Dance of Hope (祈愿之舞/祈念の舞)
skills.description: Kochou no Sei dispels 3 debuffs or control effects from 1 ally and restores their HP by 30% of her max HP. If there is excess restored HP, a shield that can absorb 5% of her max HP is created to protect them, lasts for 2 turns. Then the ally gains Butterfly's Dance, lasts for 3 turns. ;Butterfly's Dance (蝶の舞) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Increases SPD by 20 and restores HP by 8% of Kochou no Sei's max HP when damage is received (can be triggered once each turn).

upgrades.text: HP restored increases to 31%, HP restored by Butterfly's Dance increases to 9%.
